demo.expected_precedent: Grant access requests when the system is wiki, the role is read and the requester's manager approved it.

contract.label: Access requests

fields.name: manager_approved

fields.name: same_team_as_owner
fields.label: Same team as the system owner
fields.when_true: the requester is on the system owner's team
fields.when_false: the requester is not on the system owner's team
